purpose: Source- and convention-versioned rule registry for the AstroProof research engine. Structural detection is separated from effect claims.
epistemic_policy: A structural chart match is not evidence that a promised life outcome will occur.
Disputed school conventions must be named, not silently merged.
Rule changes require a new rule/version identifier so frozen predictions remain reproducible.
